geo <- st_transform(geo, 3414)
changi <- geo %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% c("CHANGI AIRPORT", "CHANGI BAY",
                          "CHANGI POINT", "CHANGI WEST"))
changi <- changi %>% 
  mutate(Station = "Changi")
changi <- changi %>%
  relocate(Station, .before = everything())
changi <- left_join(changi, c124,
                    by = c("Station" = "Station"))
